test_title: PYST 64: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 26 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: "Operation Abhyaas", a nationwide civil defence mock drill held on 7 May 2025, was organized by which of the following in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Home Affairs**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operation Abhyaas** is a significant **nationwide civil defence mock drill** organized by the **Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA)** on **7 May 2025**.
 
• The primary objective of this exercise was to assess and enhance the **preparedness, coordination, and response capabilities** of various civil defence units and local administrative bodies across **India**.
 
• The drill simulated multiple emergency scenarios, including **natural disasters** and **man-made crises**, to test the real-time mobilization of **Civil Defence volunteers** and **Home Guards**.
 
• The **Ministry of Home Affairs** orchestrated the event to ensure that the **Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)** for disaster management are effectively implemented at the **grassroots level**.
 
• This initiative is part of the government's broader strategy to strengthen **internal security** and **community resilience** during large-scale emergencies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA):**
 
 
• The **MHA** is a nodal ministry of the **Government of India** responsible for the maintenance of **internal security** and domestic policy.
 
• It oversees the **Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs)** and provides administrative support to the **Union Territories**.
 
• The ministry is headed by the **Union Home Minister**, who is a senior member of the **Union Council of Ministers**.
 
 
 
• **Civil Defence in India:**
 
 
• **Civil Defence** measures are designed to protect the **civilian population** against any hostile attack or disaster.
 
• In **India**, the **Civil Defence Act, 1968**, provides the legal framework for the organization and operation of civil defence bodies.
 
• The **Directorate General of Fire Service, Civil Defence & Home Guards** under the **MHA** coordinates these activities nationwide.
 
 
 
• **Disaster Management Framework:**
 
 
• The **Disaster Management Act, 2005**, led to the creation of the **National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)**, which is chaired by the **Prime Minister**.
 
• Mock drills like **Operation Abhyaas** are essential tools used by the **NDMA** and **MHA** to identify gaps in the **disaster response mechanism**.
 
 
 
• **Other Entities:**
 
 
• **NITI Aayog:** A policy think tank of the **Government of India** that focuses on **sustainable development goals** and cooperative federalism, but does not usually organize field-level mock drills.
 
• **Ministry of Finance:** Responsible for the **economy of India**, including taxation, financial legislation, and the **Union Budget**.
 
• **Indian Institute of Administrative Sciences:** Primarily an **academic and training institution** rather than an operational body for nationwide civil defence drills.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Geographical Reach:** The drill on **7 May 2025** covered all **States** and **Union Territories**, making it one of the largest **civil-military coordination** exercises in recent years.
 
• **Stakeholder Involvement:** Apart from the **MHA**, the exercise saw participation from the **National Disaster Response Force (NDRF)**, **State Disaster Response Forces (SDRF)**, and various **Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs)**.
 
• **Technological Integration:** During **Operation Abhyaas**, advanced communication tools and **drones** were deployed to monitor response times and simulated **search and rescue** operations.
